comments:
0e0e0dc3: /* Entry point of the routine.
Initializes variables and sets other variables to prepare for further processing. */
f37d4784: ;Executes the 'DE' label and then jumps to the 'BEGIN' label.

2a245347: ;Initializes variables used in the FileMan database engine (DIE, DIC, DP, DL, DIEL, DU).
Checks if there are any entries in the global ^VAS(393,DA) for the current DA value.
If not, it exits the routine.
b7aa3050: ;If the 0 node of ^VAS(393,DA) exists, it stores the 11th piece of that node in the local array DE(1).
f7b23775: ;If the "MSG" node of ^VAS(393,DA) exists, it stores the 1st piece of that node in the local array DE(2).
f43da558: ;Kills the local variable %Z used earlier.
f2f77448: Write the prompt with directions and display the current value.
065de91f: Quit if quit or timeout.
07e58627: Re-display the prompt on a new line if near the right margin.
b15952c7: If the data value is too long and DINUM is false or DV is a Full-Screen (FS) or Keyword editor, then allow word-wrapping.
5433902a: If the value is not null, display '// '. If DINUM is false and DV is an MUMPS input editor, if the DIHELP array exists, display '  (No Editing)' and exit.
b8c393fa: Read the response into X and set the timeout. If timed out, set X to the up-arrow.
c3faf0b7: Quit.
1dee594d: Initialize the do-quit stack.
5fee0e5a: Transfer control via the do-quit stack.
7f0e0de5: Go to the re-prompt logic if the data exists. Otherwise, write and toggle the reader.

7555eb7f: If no data is entered, go to the 'NKEY' label if a key is defined for the field. Otherwise, go to the 'A' label if the field is not required, if the data passes validation, or if the field is a date/time field with a negative value (i.e., '@' was entered). Otherwise, go to the 'X' label.
7e979521: If the user enters a '?', go to the query/help logic. If the user enters '^', do data validation and go to ^DIE17.
8fbf2f77: If the user enters '@', do data validation and go to Z^DIE2.

cc8bcc1b: If the user enters a space, and the field is a date field without the 'P'rint parameter defined, and the user has a default date value stored in ^DISV, set X to the default date value. If the field is not a date or set-of-codes field, write the default value.
880315c6: Write default value, quit if invalid data entry
00c0b768: Quit if invalid data entry
dcf99de4: Lookup value in dictionary for pointer field
c56ecdd4: Check if number is too long, reset if so
7e239723: If field allows only numeric values, convert to canonical form
c94ee10f: ;Kill all existing values for the field.
f9e5d99b: ;If input transform passes, save DIE call info for server transfer & get executable help.
00b8d069: ;Write alarm and quit if the field is not found.
c86b2a80: ;Set X to a bad value code to indicate a problem.
7d4aeb28: Sets mumps variables and branches to label B.
7f2cea51: Sets internal variable D. DV is the .01 field value of the input variable X.
cfb27680: If DE(DQ) is undefined, it executes a computed GOTO based on the value of X.
c630ab47: Sets variables DG, Y, and X based on the input DQ. If DQ has a value for the second node, it executes code stored there.
de03647f: If DG contains 'P' and a global node for X exists, it sets X to the .01 field value of that node and potentially updates DG and X based on the data dictionary.
3ed6745f: If DG contains 'V' and conditions are met, it sets X to the .01 field value of a global node computed from Y. It may also update DG and X based on the data dictionary.
4618be71: If DG contains 'D', it executes FileMan code in ^DD("DD"). If DG contains 'S', it attempts to parse a piece of X delimited by ';' + Y + ':' and store it in Y.
a8869b47: ;Check if valid data exists, if not go to the ^DIE17 routine.
4844179a: ;If input transform is not type-specific (I or #), go to reader.
c6411973: ;Call echo transform routine and if data exists go to reader, else go to prompt.
a2bf75bd: ;Exit the routine if no data input.
3a4c01f0: ;Set up DIR array to prompt for new value if DB(DQ) is defined.
01988130: ;If DB(DQ) is defined and DIQUIET is not defined, define DIQUIET=1.
8e8f2949: ;Call ^DIR to prompt for new value, store result in X and % if no ^-level error.
1da9ae1d: ;Exit the routine.
1bd33539: ;Save current field value as 'O' node in DIEZTMP global.
d77346db: ;If 'DW' x-ref exists, save it in the '4/' node of DIEZTMP.
3ceeddd6: ;Otherwise, kill the '4/' node of DIEZTMP.
eb933b5b: ;Exit the routine.
5b0ba259: If not running from TaskMan, display warning and set X to '?BAD'.
6da8c56f: Check if the KEY field is defined in the DATA input and if so, evaluate it. Otherwise return 1.
9ff10025: Set the file name, question number and data qualifier.
66722e67: If data global is defined, file data, and set up variables for the STATUS field (.11) in file #393.2.
95d2489c: Set the data global reference for file #393.2.
24dbcfba: Set X to the value of DGJTST.
652772b2: Set Y to the value of X.
a585b25e: If X is null, go to the 'N' code in DIE17. If X is not null and the 'INPUT TRANSFORM' exists, execute it. If X is then defined, set the respective data field.
56cc23a7: If X equals '@', go to the 'RD' label.
b9ddc9ff: Quit if there are no arguments passed to the routine.
36a4f124: Set properties and values related to the data fields and labels.
5883549f: Branch to the RE label.
2cf8e82a: Validate the length of the X input variable and kill it if it's too long or too short.
b6af625d: Check if X exists and contains only alphanumeric printable characters; kill X if it doesn't.
3df6a3cd: Quit the routine.
bef02620: Branch to the ^DIE17 routine.
